# SFTP Manager Changelog

## 1.3.2

- FIX top-level počet mountpointů používá stejný local+template resolver jako user detail, takže template-only uživatel už není zobrazen jako `mountpointy:0`.
- FIX CIFS preflight vyhodnocuje enabled effective local+template mountpointy; template-only Samba user už nemůže obejít kontrolu `cifs-utils`, zatímco pouze disabled pointy ji zbytečně nevyžadují.
- UPD Apply používá JBLibs hotfix s resolver-based validací template-only uživatelů.

## v2.2.7

- FIX SFTP Manager 1.3.2 sjednocuje top-level počet mountpointů a CIFS preflight s local+template resolverem; template-only uživatelé se správně počítají a Apply je nepovažuje za prázdné.
- FIX SFTP Manager 1.3.1

replacements.old: - Apply must resolve local + template mountpoints through JBLibs before touching the system. Disabled records stay visible/configured but are excluded from effective desired mounts, so existing physical mountpoints are removed and not recreated. Duplicate effective labels or invalid/missing templates fail closed before user mutation. Deleting or unassigning a template mount prunes its per-user stable-ID overrides so recreated access never revives implicitly.
replacements.new: - Apply must resolve local + template mountpoints through JBLibs before touching the system. Disabled records stay visible/configured but are excluded from effective desired mounts, so existing physical mountpoints are removed and not recreated. Duplicate effective labels or invalid/missing templates fail closed before user mutation. Deleting or unassigning a template mount prunes its per-user stable-ID overrides so recreated access never revives implicitly. Top-level configured mountpoint counts must use the same resolver (including disabled records), while CIFS preflight must use only enabled effective records; never infer either from raw `sftpmounts`.
